note: Summarised from official scheme portals by the development team. NOT yet verified by a human reviewer (T0.12). Every scheme links to its official source; final eligibility is decided by the scheme authority. Criteria use profile fields; an unknown field gives 'unknown', never a guess.

fields.is_cultivator: bool: owner, tenant or sharecropper farming land
fields.govt_employee_excluded: bool: serving or retired government officer (other than Group D / MTS)
fields.pensioner_10k_plus: bool: monthly pension of ₹10,000 or more (other than Group D / MTS)
fields.practising_professional: bool: registered doctor, engineer, lawyer, CA or architect in practice
fields.grows_notified_crop: bool: grows a crop notified for insurance in the area this season
fields.runs_micro_enterprise: bool: runs or is starting a non-farm income-generating micro or small business

schemes.name: PM-KISAN
schemes.summary: Income support of ₹6,000 a year, paid in three instalments of ₹2,000, to eligible landholding farmer families.

benefit.text: ₹6,000 a year in three instalments of ₹2,000

criteria.label: Family owns cultivable land
criteria.ask: Does your family own farmland in its name?

criteria.label: Not an institutional landholder
criteria.ask: Is the land held by a trust, company or institution?

criteria.label: No family member paid income tax last assessment year
criteria.ask: Did anyone in your family pay income tax last year?

criteria.label: No family member holds a constitutional post
criteria.ask: Does anyone in the family hold or hold a constitutional post (MP, MLA, minister and similar)?

criteria.label: Not a serving or retired government officer (Group D / MTS are not excluded)
criteria.ask: Is anyone a serving or retired government officer above Group D?

criteria.label: No pension of ₹10,000 a month or more (Group D / MTS are not excluded)
criteria.ask: Does anyone get a pension of ₹10,000 a month or more?

criteria.label: Not a practising doctor, engineer, lawyer, CA or architect
criteria.ask: Is anyone a registered professional in practice?

documents: Land ownership record (for example 7/12 extract or RTC)

steps.text: Register on the PM-KISAN portal (Farmers Corner) or at a Common Service Centre.
Complete e-KYC with Aadhaar; it is required to receive instalments.
Your state verifies land records; then instalments go to your bank account.
Check status on the portal using Aadhaar or registration number.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
schemes.summary: Crop insurance against yield loss from natural risks, for notified crops in notified areas.

benefit.text: Claim for insured yield loss. Farmer premium is capped: 2% of sum insured for kharif, 1.5% for rabi, 5% for commercial and horticultural crops.

criteria.label: Grows crops as owner, tenant or sharecropper
criteria.ask: Do you grow crops this season, on your own or rented land?

criteria.label: Crop is notified for insurance in your area this season
criteria.ask: Is your crop on the notified list for your area? Your bank, CSC or the PMFBY portal can tell you.

documents: Land record or tenancy / sowing certificate

steps.text: Before the season's cut-off date, apply through your bank, a Common Service Centre or the PMFBY portal.
Pay your share of the premium and keep the receipt.
Report crop loss quickly through the crop insurance app, helpline or your bank, as the scheme rules require.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card
schemes.authority: Banks, under RBI and NABARD guidelines
schemes.summary: A bank credit limit for crop cultivation and allied activities such as animal husbandry and fisheries.

benefit.text: Short-term credit at concessional interest through banks; interest subvention schemes apply to eligible limits. Confirm current rates with your bank.

criteria.label: Farmer (owner, tenant, sharecropper) or engaged in animal husbandry or fisheries
criteria.ask: Do you farm, keep animals or fish for income?

criteria.label: Can open or has a bank account
criteria.ask: Do you have a bank account?

steps.text: Visit your bank branch (commercial, regional rural or cooperative bank) and ask for the KCC application.
Submit the form with documents; the bank sets a limit based on your crops and land.
Repay on time to keep any interest benefits.

schemes.name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
schemes.summary: Life cover of ₹2 lakh for bank account holders aged 18 to 50, renewed every year.

benefit.text: ₹2 lakh to the nominee on death from any cause. Yearly premium of ₹436, auto-debited.

criteria.label: Aged 18 to 50 when joining
criteria.ask: What is your age?

criteria.label: Has a savings bank or post office account
criteria.ask: Do you have a savings bank account?

steps.text: Enrol through your bank branch, net banking or the Jan Suraksha portal.
Give consent for yearly auto-debit of the premium.

schemes.name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
schemes.summary: Accident cover for bank account holders aged 18 to 70, renewed every year.

benefit.text: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or total permanent disability, ₹1 lakh for partial permanent disability. Yearly premium of ₹20.

criteria.label: Aged 18 to 70
criteria.ask: What is your age?

criteria.label: Has a savings bank or post office account
criteria.ask: Do you have a savings bank account?

steps.text: Enrol through your bank branch, net banking or the Jan Suraksha portal.
Give consent for yearly auto-debit of the premium.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana
schemes.summary: A guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 a month from age 60, for subscribers who join between 18 and 40.

benefit.text: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 from 60, depending on contribution and joining age.

criteria.label: Aged 18 to 40 when joining
criteria.ask: What is your age?

criteria.label: Has a savings bank account
criteria.ask: Do you have a savings bank account?

criteria.label: Not an income-tax payer (rule from 1 October 2022)
criteria.ask: Do you pay income tax?

steps.text: Register at your bank or post office, or online through your bank.
Choose the pension amount; monthly contributions are auto-debited.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.summary: A savings account for a girl child under 10, opened by a parent or guardian, with a government-set interest rate.

benefit.text: Deposits from ₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh a year; interest rate set by the government each quarter.

criteria.label: Parent or guardian of a girl under 10
criteria.ask: Do you have a daughter under 10?

steps.text: Open the account at a post office or authorised bank with the first deposit.

schemes.name: PM Mudra Yojana
schemes.authority: Banks, NBFCs and MFIs under MUDRA
schemes.summary: Loans for non-farm micro and small businesses, in categories up to ₹20 lakh.

benefit.text: Business loans in Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus categories, up to ₹20 lakh.

criteria.label: Runs or is starting a non-farm income-generating business
criteria.ask: Do you run or plan a small business (not farming)?

documents: Business plan or proof of business

steps.text: Apply at a bank, NBFC or microfinance institution, or through the official portal.

schemes.name: UDID card (Unique Disability ID)
schemes.authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
schemes.summary: A single national disability ID and certificate that many disability benefits ask for.

benefit.text: One ID accepted across states for disability benefits and concessions.

criteria.label: Has a disability
criteria.ask: Do you have a disability?

steps.text: Apply online on the Swavlamban card portal.
Attend the medical assessment at the hospital you are assigned.
Download the e-card; the physical card is posted to you.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
schemes.authority: Ministry of Rural Development (NSAP), through states
schemes.summary: A monthly pension for adults with severe or multiple disabilities in below-poverty-line households. States may add to the central amount.

benefit.text: Central assistance of ₹300 a month (more from age 80), often topped up by the state. Confirm with your state.

criteria.label: Aged 18 to 79
criteria.ask: What is your age?

criteria.label: Disability of 80% or more
criteria.ask: What percentage is on your disability certificate?

criteria.label: Household is below the poverty line
criteria.ask: Is your household on the BPL list?

steps.text: Apply to your gram panchayat, municipality or district social welfare office, as your state requires.
